# DestinationGo Travel

> Luxury travel planning for empty nesters and retirees. Specializing in Europe, all-inclusive resorts, and cruises.

DestinationGo Travel is a luxury travel agency run by Dawn Owens, a travel advisor based in Upstate South Carolina. Dawn plans trips for empty nesters and retirees who want a well-designed, fully-handled travel experience — not a DIY booking. Her service is personal, thorough, and free to clients (she earns commissions from suppliers).

## About Dawn Owens

Dawn Owens is a luxury travel advisor with 5+ years of experience and firsthand knowledge of 15+ countries. She specializes in three areas: European travel (river cruises, city immersions, countryside escapes, multi-country tours), all-inclusive resorts (Caribbean, Mexico, Maldives), and cruises (river, ocean, and expedition). She serves clients primarily in Greenville, Spartanburg, Anderson, and Clemson, SC, but works with travelers nationwide.

## Services

- Europe travel planning: itineraries, river cruises, city stays, and countryside escapes
- All-inclusive resort selection: Dawn knows which properties actually deliver on their promise
- Cruise planning: matching clients to the right ship, itinerary, and cabin
- Travel insurance guidance: helping clients understand and select coverage
- End-to-end trip management: transfers, pre-arrival notes, logistics, and support during travel
